primary_external_validation.conclusion: The frozen MS3 Core50 independently reproduced proliferative/G2M, mitotic-entry and spindle-chromosome-segregation biology.

secondary_biological_validation.conclusion: Reciprocal proliferative versus hepatic/metabolic organization was supported at patient-pseudobulk resolution and after technical adjustment, but was not uniformly reproduced at unadjusted single-cell resolution.

regulatory_validation.primary: The frozen Step29 MS3 regulator architecture was supported at patient-pseudobulk level.
regulatory_validation.secondary: The MS6 regulator architecture showed cell-level concordance but lacked robust patient-level replication.

signaling_validation.primary: The frozen IFNAR1-PI3K-AKT-BRCA1 receiver-side expression architecture showed directional consistency with the independent MS3-like program.
signaling_validation.interpretation: Supportive mechanistic consistency only; not evidence of physical communication or causal pathway activation.

firewall: Malignancy was defined independently of Core50.
Step30 communication networks were not rediscovered.
No new external-data-driven malignant state was created.
article_main_message: Independent single-cell validation supports the conserved MS3 proliferative/mitotic high-risk program as the most reproducible malignant-cell feature, with secondary support for a reciprocal differentiated/metabolic axis and associated regulatory/signaling architectures.
